{"implementation": "def solve(case):
    payload = case["payload"]
    word_token_indices = payload["word_token_indices"]
    word_scores = payload["word_scores"]
    forced_words = payload["forced_words"]
    token_budget = payload["token_budget"]

    # validation
    n = len(word_token_indices)
    if len(word_scores) != n:
        raise ValueError("Inconsistent lengths")
    # forced words validation
    for idx in forced_words:
        if not (0 <= idx < n):
            raise ValueError("Invalid forced word index")
    # token counts
    word_token_counts = [len(tokens) for tokens in word_token_indices]
    forced_tokens_total = sum(word_token_counts[idx] for idx in forced_words)
    if forced_tokens_total > token_budget:
        # infeasible
        return {"words": [], "tokens": []}

    selected = set(forced_words)
    remaining_budget = token_budget - forced_tokens_total

    # candidates: indices not forced, with (score, index)
    candidates = [(word_scores[i], i) for i in range(n) if i not in selected]
    candidates.sort(key=lambda x: (-x[0], x[1]))  # descending score, ascending index

    for score, idx in candidates:
        cnt = word_token_counts[idx]
        if cnt <= remaining_budget:
            selected.add(idx)
            remaining_budget -= cnt

    # build output in original order
    words_out = []
    tokens_out = []
    for i in range(n):
        if i in selected:
            words_out.append(i)
            tokens_out.extend(word_token_indices[i])
    return {"words": words_out, "tokens": tokens_out}"}
